:byline: Ada Lovelace, Notes

== Delimiters

[quote, A [x] B, Notes]
____
Balanced brackets.
____

[quote, A [x, Notes]
____
Unmatched opening bracket.
____

[quote, A ] B, Notes]
____
Extra closing bracket.
____

[quote, https://example.com[Someone, Part 1], Final]
____
Unquoted comma.
____

[quote, "https://example.com[Someone, Part 1]", Final]
____
Quoted comma.
____

[quote, "Quoted author"Adjacent citation, Fourth slot]
____
Quote-delimited slot.
____

== Slots

[quote, , Empty-slot citation]
____
Empty slot.
____

[quote, custom=value, Named-slot citation]
____
Named slot.
____

[quote, attribution=Named Author, Positional Citation]
____
Named author.
____

[quote, Positional Author, citetitle=Named Citation]
____
Named citation.
____

[quote, attribution=Named Author, citetitle=Named Citation]
____
Both fields named.
____

[quote, attribution=None, citetitle=Literal Value]
____
Unset None value.
____

[quote, attribution="None", citetitle=Quoted Literal]
____
Quoted None value.
____

[quote, None, Positional Literal]
____
Positional None value.
____

[quote, attribution = "Comma, Author", citetitle = Work]
____
Spaced equals signs.
____

[quote, {byline}]
____
Expanded slots.
____

== Stacked lists

[quote, Original Author]
[citetitle=Named Citation]
____
Named-only stack.
____

[quote, Original Author, Original Citation]
[, Replacement Author]
____
Positional overlay stack.
____

[quote, Original Author, Original Citation]
[verse, Replacement Poet, Replacement Poem]
____
Style replacement stack.
____

== Substitutions

[quote, Ada *Lovelace*, `Notes`]
____
Unquoted values.
____

[quote, "Grace *Hopper*", "`Compiler`"]
____
Double-quoted values.
____

[quote, 'Margaret *Hamilton*', '`Apollo`']
____
Single-quoted formatting.
____

[quote, 'A\'B', Notes]
____
Escaped single quote.
____

[quote, https://example.com[Literal Author], https://example.org[Literal Work]]
____
Unquoted macros.
____

[quote, 'https://example.com[Linked Author]', 'https://example.org[Linked Work]']
____
Single-quoted macros.
____

[quote, attribution='Named *Author*', citetitle='`Named Work`']
____
Named substitutions.
____

== Quote and verse forms

[quote, 'Paragraph *Author*', '`Paragraph Work`']
Styled quote paragraph.

[quote, , Paragraph citation only]
Citation-only quote paragraph.

[verse, 'Paragraph *Poet*', '`Paragraph Poem`']
Styled verse paragraph.

[verse, 'Block *Poet*', '`Block Poem`']
____
Delimited verse block.
____

== Styles

[quote#styled-quote.lead%fragment, Ada]
____
Adjacent shorthand.
____

[quote #not-an-id, Ada]
Spaces disable shorthand.

[quote[x], Ada]
Bracketed unknown style.

[[not an anchor]]
Double-bracket anchor syntax with spaces remains text.

[#only-id.lead%fragment]
Shorthand-only metadata.
